description: googleAdLibrary: Company Ads. GET /v1/google/company/ads. Provide one of: advertiser_id, domain. Get public company ads with dates when available (1 credit). Set get_ad_details=true for full details (25 credits). firstShown can be null in detail responses even when the default list has it. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Costs 25 credits when get_ad_details is set. Costs 0 credits when ads is empty. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

advertiser_id.description: The advertiser id of the company

end_date.description: End date to search for. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

get_ad_details.description: Set true to include ad details for 25 credits per request; otherwise IDs only for 1 credit.

region.description: The region to search for. Defaults to anywhere

start_date.description: Start date to search for. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

topic.description: Topic to search for. Political searches also require region, such as US or AU.

name: google_company_ads
